question: In evidence.zip, use the d99-- member. Submit true exactly when any imported DLL name equals kernel32.dll (case-insensitive) and no imported DLL name contains msvcrt. Submit lowercase true or false.
generator_cmd: python3 -m ziglang cc -target x86_64-windows-gnu -O1 -o gf_pe_imports.exe gf_pe_imports.c -luser32 -lws2_32 (existing member)
oracle_cmd: { python3 -c "import pefile; p=pefile.PE('gf_pe_imports.exe'); [print(e.dll.decode()) for e in p.DIRECTORY_ENTRY_IMPORT]" | grep -qix kernel32.dll && ! python3 -c "import pefile; p=pefile.PE('gf_pe_imports.exe'); [print(e.dll.decode()) for e in p.DIRECTORY_ENTRY_IMPORT]" | grep -q msvcrt; } && echo true || echo false
